dhavira (nabhiye! nIGghaL avarghaLughghu JAbhaghamUDhDhuGghaL:) andha jhiSyarghaL (IsAvai noghghi) "maryamuDhaiya maghan2 IsAve! uGghaLuDhaiya ir2aivan2, vAn2adhdhilirundhu èGghaLughghAgha or uNavu(bh bhòruLghaL niraMbhiya) dhaDhDhai ir2aghghi vaighgha muDhiyumA?" èn2r2u gheDhDhadhar2ghu (IsA, avarghaLai noghghi) "mèyyAghave nIGghaL naMbhighghai ghòNDhavarghaLAgha irundhAl (idhdhaghaiya gheLvi gheDhbhadhaibh bhar2r2i) allAhvughghu nIGghaL bhayandhu ghòLLuGghaL" èn2r2u ghUr2in2Ar.

(an2r2i) nI èn2aghghu eviyabhaDhiye nAn2 (avarghaLai noghghi) "nIGghaL èn2aghghuM uGghaLughghuM ir2aivan2Aghiya allAhvaiye vaNaGghuGghaL" èn2r2u ghUr2in2en2eyan2r2i ver2òn2r2aiyuM (òrubhodhuM) nAn2 ghUr2avillai. nAn2 avarghaLuDhan2 irundha varaiyil avarghaLin2 jhèyalai nAn2 bhArdhdhugh ghòNDhirundhen2. nI èn2n2aigh ghaibhbhar2r2iya bhin2n2ar nIdhAn2 avarghaLaigh ghavan2idhdhavan2Agha irundhAy. an2aidhdhir2ghuM nIye jhADhjhi.

(annALil) avarghaLaibh bhar2r2i allAhvuM maghizhjhjhiyaDhaivAn2. avarghaLuM avan2aibh bhar2r2i maghizhjhjhi aDhaivArghaL. idhu mighgha maghadhdhAn2a bhèruM bhAghghiyaM.
vAn2aGghaLil uLLavaiyuM, bhUmiyil uLLavaiyuM, ivaighaLiluLLa an2aidhdhin2 ADhjhi allAhvughghuriyadhe! avan2 (ivai) an2aidhdhin2 mIdhuM mighgha Ar2r2aluDhaiyavan2.

(Aghave, avarghaL ghaDhDhiyirundha maghadhdhAn2a dhòru eriyai uDhaighghagh ghUDhiya) bhèruM vèLLadhdhai avarghaLughghugh gheDhAgha an2ubhbhi vaidhdhoM. avarghaLuDhaiya (un2n2adhamAn2a ghan2ighaLaiyuDhaiya) iru jholaighaLaigh ghajhabhbhuM, bhuLibhbhumuLLa ghAyghaLaiyuDhaiya maraGghaLaiyuM, jhila ilandhai maraGghaLaiyuM ghòNDha dhobhbhughaLAgha mAr2r2iviDhDhoM.
naMmuDhaiya nan2r2iyai mar2andhadhar2ghu idhan2ai nAM avarghaLughghugh ghUliyAghagh ghòDhudhdhoM. nan2r2i ghèDhDhavar ghaLughghan2r2i (mar2r2èvarughghuM idhdhaghaiya) ghUliyai nAM ghòDhubhbhomA?

avarghaLuDhaiya UrughghuM nAM aruLbhurindha (siriyAviluLLa jhèzhibhbhAn2a) UrghaLughghuM iDhaiyil dhòDharjhjhiyAghabh bhala ghirAmaGghaLaiyuM uNDhubhaNNi avaighaLil bhAdhaighaLaiyuM amaidhdhu "iravu bhaghal èndha neradhdhiluM ajhjhamar2r2avarghaLAgha adhil bhirayANaM jhèyyuGghaL" (èn2r2u ghUr2iyirundhoM).

An2Al, avarghaL (indha nan2r2iyaibh bhur2aghghaNidhdhu "dhòDharjhjhiyAgha UrghaL irubhbhadhu èGghaL bhayaNadhdhir2ghu in2bhaM aLighghavillai.) èGghaL ir2aivan2e! èGghaL bhayaNaGghaL nèDhundhUramAghuMbhaDhijh jhèy(vadhar2ghAgha madhdhiyil dhòDharjhjhiyAgha uLLa ighghirAmaGghaLai azhidhdhuviDhu)vAyAgha!" èn2r2u bhirArdhdhidhdhudh dhamaghghudh dhAme dhIGghizhaidhdhugh ghòNDhan2ar. Aghave, (avarghaLaiyuM avarghaLuDhaiya nagharaGghaLaiyuM azhidhdhu) avarghaLaiyuM bhala iDhaGghaLughghujh jhidhar2aDhidhdhubh bhalaruM (izhivAghabh) bhejhaghghUDhiya ghadhaighaLAghghi viDhDhoM. bhòr2umaiyuDhaiyavarghaL, nan2r2i jhèludhdhubhavarghaL òvvòruvarughghuM nijhjhayaM idhil bhala bhaDhibhbhin2aighaL irughghin2r2an2a.

nijhjhayamAgha (avarghaL dhan2n2aibh bhin2bhar2r2uvArghaLèn2r2u) ibhlIs èNNiya èNNadhdhai uNmai èn2r2e avan2 ghaNDhu ghòNDhAn2. Aghave, naMbhighghai ghòNDha jhilaraidh dhavira (mar2r2a) avarghaL an2aivaruM avan2aiye bhin2bhar2r2in2ArghaL.

èn2in2uM, avarghaLai nirbhbhandhighgha avan2ughghu yAdhòru adhighAramuM illai. Ayin2uM, mar2umaiyai naMbhAdha avarghaLil (mar2umaiyai) naMbhubhavar èvar èn2bhadhai nAM dhèLivAgha ar2ividhdhu viDhuvadhar2ghAghave ivvAr2u naDhaibhèr2r2adhu. uGghaLadhu ir2aivan2e èllA bhòruLghaLaiyuM bhAdhughAbhbhavan2Agha irughghir2An2.

(nabhiye!) nIGghaL ghUr2uGghaL: allAhvaiyan2r2i èvaighaLai nIGghaL (dhèyvaGghaLèn2a) èNNigh ghòNDhIrghaLo avaighaLai nIGghaL azhaidhdhubh bhAruGghaL. vAn2adhdhilo bhUmiyilo avaighaLughghu or aNuvaLavuM adhighAraM illai. an2r2i, avaighaLai bhaDhaibhbhadhil ivaighaLughghu èdhdhaghaiya jhaMbhandhamuM illai. (avaighaLai bhaDhaibhbhadhil) ivai avan2ughghu udhavi jhèyyavumillai.

avan2uDhaiya an2umadhi bhèr2r2avarghaLaidh dhavira (mar2r2èndha malaghghuM) avan2iDhadhdhil bharindhu bhejhuvadhuM bhayan2aLighghAdhu. (allAhvuDhaiya yAdhòru ghaDhDhaLai bhir2aghghuM jhamayadhdhil avarghaL bhayandhu naDhuGghughin2r2an2ar.) avarghaLuDhaiya uLLadhdhil irundhu naDhughghaM nIGghiyadhuM (avarghaLil òruvar mar2r2avarghaLai noghghi) "uGghaL ir2aivan2 èn2n2a ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhAn2?" èn2r2u gheDhbhArghaL. adhar2ghu mar2r2avarghaL "(iDhaveNDhiya) niyAyamAn2a ghaDhDhaLaiyaiye iDhDhAn2; avan2o mighgha melAn2avan2uM mighabh bhèriyavan2uM AvAn2" èn2r2u ghUr2uvArghaL.

(nabhiye! nirAgharighghuM ivarghaLai noghghi) "vAn2adhdhil irundhuM bhUmiyil irundhuM uGghaLughghu uNavaLibhbhavan2 yAr?" èn2r2u gheLuGghaL. (adhar2ghu avarghaL bhadhil ghUr2uvadhèn2n2a?) "allAhdhAn2" èn2r2u (nIGghaLe) ghUr2i "mèyyAghave nerAn2a vazhiyil irubhbhavar yAr? bhaghiraGghamAn2a dhavar2An2a vazhiyil irubhbhavan2 yAr? (nIGghaLA alladhu nAn2A?)" èn2r2uM gheLuGghaL.
(nabhiye!) nIGghaL ghUr2uGghaL: "nAGghaL jhèyyuM ghur2r2aGghaLaibh bhar2r2i nIGghaL gheDhghabhbhaDha mADhDhIrghaL; (avvAr2e) nIGghaL jhèybhavaighaLaibh bhar2r2i nAGghaL gheDhghabhbhaDha mADhDhoM"

(meluM) nIGghaL ghUr2uGghaL: "muDhivil (mar2umai nALil) namadhir2aivan2 naM an2aivaraiyuM òn2r2u jherdhdhu namaghghiDhaiyil nIdhamAghave dhIrbhbhaLibhbhAn2. avan2 dhIrbhbhaLibhbhadhil mighgha melAn2avan2uM (an2aidhdhaiyuM) mighgha nan2ghar2indhavan2AghavuM irughghin2r2An2."

(an2r2i) "allAhvughghu iNaiyAn2avaiyèn2a(gh ghUr2i) nIGghaL avan2ughghujh jhamamAghajh jherdhdhu vaighghin2r2IrghaLe avaighaLai nIGghaL èn2aghghugh ghANbhiyuGghaL" (èn2r2u gheDhDhu "avan2ughghu òruvarume iNai) illai. avan2o an2aivaraiyuM mighaidhdhavan2uM JAn2amuDhaiyavan2umAghiya allAhvAghuM" èn2r2u ghUr2uGghaL.

(nabhiye!) nAM uGghaLai (ivvulaghadhdhil uLLa) èllA man2idharghaLughghume nar2jhèydhi ghUr2ubhavarAghavuM, ajhjhamUDhDhi èjhjharighghai jhèybhavarAghavuM an2ubhbhi vaidhdhirughghin2r2oM. èn2in2uM, man2idharil bhèruMbhAlAn2avarghaL (idhan2ai) ar2indhu ghòLLavillai.
(nabhiye!) "nIGghaL uNmai jhòlbhavarAgha irundhAl (vijhAraNaigh ghAlaM èn2r2u) nIGghaL ghUr2uM vAghghur2udhi èbhbhòzhudhu varuM?" èn2r2u avarghaL gheDhghin2r2an2ar.
adhar2ghu nIGghaL ghUr2uGghaL: "uGghaLughghAgha òru nAL ghur2ibhbhiDhabhbhaDhDhirughghin2r2adhu. adhilirundhu nIGghaL òru nAzhighai bhindhavumADhDhIrghaL; mundhavumADhDhIrghaL."

"nijhjhayamAgha nAGghaL indhagh ghurAn2aiyuM naMbhamADhDhoM; idhar2ghu mun2n2uLLa vedhaGghaLaiyuM (naMbhamADhDhoM)" èn2r2uM indha nirAgharibhbhavarghaL ghUr2ughin2r2an2ar. Aghave, ivvaghghiramagh ghArarghaL dhaGghaL ir2aivan2 mun2 nir2udhdhabhbhaDhDhu avarghaLil (jhilar jhilarai nindhibhbhadhaiyuM) bhalavIn2amAn2avarghaL gharvaM ghòNDha varghaLai noghghi "nIGghaL illAviDhil nijhjhayamAgha nAGghaL naMbhighghai ghòNDheyirubhbhoM" èn2r2u ghUr2uvadhaiyuM nIGghaL bhArbhbhIrAyin2 (avarghaLin2 izhi nilaimaiyaigh ghaNDhu ghòLvIrghaL).

adhar2ghu (avarghaLil) gharvaM ghòNDhirundhavarghaL bhalavIn2amAgha irundhavarghaLai noghghi "uGghaLiDhaM nerAn2a vazhi vandhadhan2 bhin2n2ar (nIGghaL adhil jhèllAdhu) nAGghaLA uGghaLaidh dhaDhudhdhugh ghòNDhoM? (avvAr2u) illai; nIGghaLdhAM (adhil jhèllAdhu) ghur2r2avALighaLAn2IrghaL" èn2r2u ghUr2uvArghaL.

adhar2ghu, bhalavIn2amAyirundhavarghaL gharvaM ghòNDhirun dhavarghaLai noghghi "èn2n2e! nAGghaL allAhvai nirAgharidhdhu viDhDhu avan2ughghu iNaivaighghumAr2u nIGghaL èGghaLai evi, iravu bhaghalAgha jhUzhjhjhi jhèyyavillaiyA?" èn2r2u ghUr2uvArghaL. Aghave, ivarghaL an2aivarume vedhan2aiyaigh (ghaNNAl) ghANuM jhamayadhdhil dhaGghaL dhughghadhdhai mar2aidhdhughghòNDhu (ivvAr2u) ghUr2uvArghaL. An2Al, nirAgharidhdhavarghaLuDhaiya ghazhudhdhughaLil nAM vilaGghiDhDhu viDhuvoM. ivarghaL jhèydhughòNDhirundha (dhIya) jhèyalughghudh dhaghgha ghUliyaiyan2r2i mar2r2èdhuvuM ghòDhughghabh bhaDhuvArghaLA?

nAM naMmuDhaiya ajhjhamUDhDhi èjhjharighghai jhèyyuM dhUdharai èGghèGghu an2ubhbhin2omo aGghèllAM irundha jhèlvandharghaL (avarai noghghi) "nijhjhayamAgha nAM nIGghaL ghòNDhu vandha dhUdhai nirAgharighghin2r2oM" èn2r2u ghUr2Amal irughghavillai.

(adhar2ghu nabhiye!) nIGghaL ghUr2uGghaL: "nijhjhayamAgha èn2 ir2aivan2, dhAn2 viruMbhiyavarghaLughghubh bhòruLai adhighamAghavuM ghòDhughghin2r2An2; (dhAn2 viruMbhiyavarghaLughghugh) ghur2aidhdhuM viDhughin2r2An2. èn2in2uM, man2idharil bhèruMbhAlAn2avarghaL (idhan2ai) ar2indhu ghòLvadhillai."

(nIGghaL èNNughir2avAr2u) uGghaLuDhaiya bhòruLghaLuM jhandhadhighaLuM uGghaLai naMmiDhaM jherghghagh ghUDhiyavaighaLalla. Ayin2uM, èvarghaL naMbhighghai ghòNDhu nar2jhèyalghaLaijh jhèyghir2ArghaLo (avaiye avarghaLai naMmiDhaM jherghghuM.) idhdhaghaiyavarghaLughghu avarghaL jhèydha (nar2)jhèyalin2 ghAraNamAgha iraDhDhibhbhAn2a ghUliyuNDhu. an2r2i, avarghaL (jhuvan2abhadhiyiluLLa) mel mADhighaLil ghavalaiyar2r2uM vajhibhbhArghaL.
èvarghaL naMmuDhaiya vajhan2aGghaLughghu èdhiriDhaiyAgha muyar2jhighghin2r2ArghaLo avarghaL (naMmuDhaiya) vedhan2aiyai aDhaivadhar2ghAgha (naMmun2) ghòNDhu varabhbhaDhuvArghaL.

(adhar2ghuL LAghave) ivarghaL èn2adhu dhUdharghaLaibh bhòyyAghgha mur2bhaDhDhu irughghin2r2an2ar. (nabhiye!) nIGghaL ghUr2uGghaL: "nAn2 uGghaLughghu ubhadhejhibhbha dhèllAM òre òru viSayaMdhAn2. nIGghaL òvvòruvarAghavo, iraNDhiraNDhu bherghaLAghavo allAhvughghAghajh jhir2idhu bhòr2udhdhirundhu, bhin2n2ar (uGghaLughghuL) Alojhidhdhubh bhAruGghaL. uGghaLuDhaiya jhineghidharAghiya èn2aghghu èdhdhaghaiya bhaidhdhiyamuM illai. (nAn2 uGghaLughghugh) ghaDhin2amAn2a vedhan2ai varuvadhar2ghu mun2n2ar (adhan2aibh bhar2r2i) ajhjhamUDhDhi èjhjharighghai jhèyghir2ava n2eyan2r2i ver2illai.

(meluM) nIGghaL ghUr2uGghaL: nijhjhayamAgha èn2adhu ir2aivan2 (bhòyyai azhibhbhadhar2ghAgha) mèyyaidh dhèLivAghghughin2r2An2. mar2aivAn2avai an2aidhdhaiyuM avan2 nan2ghar2indhavan2.

(meluM) nIGghaL ghUr2uGghaL: "nAn2 vazhi dhavar2iyirundhAl adhu èn2aghghe naSDhamAghuM. nAn2 nerAn2a vazhiyai aDhaindhu irundhAl adhu èn2 ir2aivan2 èn2aghghu vahI mUlamAgha ar2ividh dhadhan2 ghAraNamAghaveyAghuM. nijhjhayamAgha avan2 (an2aidhdhaiyuM) jhèviyur2ubhavan2AghavuM (an2aidhdhir2ghuM) jhamIbhamAn2avan2AghavuM irughghin2r2An2.

(ajhjhamayaM) ivarghaL (dhiDhughghiDhDhu naMbhighghai ghòNDhoM) naMbhighghai ghòNDhoM èn2r2u ghadhar2uvArghaL. (jhadhdhiyadhdhilirundhu) ivvaLavu dhUraM jhèn2r2uviDhDha ivarghaL (uNmaiyAn2a naMbhighghaiyai) èvvAr2u aDhaindhu viDhuvArghaL?
idhar2ghu mun2n2aro, ivarghaL adhan2ai nirAgharidhdhugh ghòNDhuM, ivvaLavu dhUradhdhil avarghaLughghu mar2aidhdhirundhadhaibh (bhòy èn2r2u) bhidhar2r2ighghòNDhuM irundhan2ar.

avarghaLughghuM avarghaL viruMbhiyavaighaLughghuM iDhaiyil dhaDhai er2bhaDhudhdhabhbhaDhDhu viDhuM. avvAr2e ivarghaLughghu mun2n2irundha ivarghaL in2adhdhArughghujh jhèyyabhbhaDhDhadhu. en2èn2r2Al, nijhjhayamAgha avarghaLuM bhèruM jhandheghadhdhil Azhndhe ghiDhandhan2ar.

èllAbh bhughazhuM allAhvughghe! vAn2aGghaLaiyuM bhUmiyaiyuM avan2e bhaDhaidhdhAn2. malaghghughaLaidh dhan2n2uDhaiya dhUdhaigh ghòNDhu bhoghir2avarghaLAghavuM Aghghin2An2. avarghaL iraNDhiraNDhu, muMmUn2r2u, nAn2ghu nAn2ghu ir2aghghaighaL uDhaiyavarghaLAgha irughghin2r2an2ar. avan2 viruMbhiyadhaidh dhan2 bhaDhaibhbhil bhin2n2uM adhigharibhbhAn2. nijhjhayamAgha allAh an2aidhdhin2 mIdhuM Ar2r2aluDhaiyavan2.

Aghave, (avan2ai viDhDhu) nIGghaL èGghu vèruNDhoDhughin2r2IrghaL?

(nabhiye!) avarghaL uGghaLaibh bhòyyAghghin2Al (adhar2ghAgha nIGghaL ghavalaibhbhaDhAdhIrghaL.) ivvAr2e uGghaLughghu mun2n2ar vandha dhUdhar bhalaruM bhòyyAghghabhbhaDhDhan2ar. allAhviDhame èllA ghAriyaGghaLuM ghòNDhu varabhbhaDhuM.

(nabhiye!) adhar2ghu nIGghaL ghUr2uGghaL: "mudhal mur2aiyil adhan2aibh bhaDhaidhdhavan2 èvan2o avan2e adhan2ai uyirbhbhibhbhAn2. avan2o èllA bhaDhaibhbhin2adhdhaiyuM migha ar2indhavan2.
an2r2i, avan2e bhajhumaiyAn2a maradhdhilirundhu uGghaLughghu nèrubhbhai uNDhu bhaNNughir2An2. bhin2n2ar, adhan2aigh ghòNDhu nIGghaL (uGghaLughghu veNDhiya nèrubhbhai) mUDhDhigh ghòLghin2r2IrghaL.

vAn2aGghaLaiyuM bhUmiyaiyuM bhaDhaidhdhavan2 (ghevalaM) avarghaLaibh bhon2r2avarghaLaibh bhaDhaighghajh jhaghdhiyar2r2avan2A? nijhjhayamAgha avan2e mighabhbhèriya bhaDhaibhbhALan2uM migha nan2ghar2indhavan2uM AvAn2.
avan2 yAdhòru bhòruLai(bh bhaDhaighgha)gh gharudhin2Al adhan2ai "Aghugha!" èn2agh ghUr2uvadhudhAn2 (dhAmadhaM). uDhan2 adhu AghiviDhughin2r2adhu.
jhaghalavar2r2in2 adhighAramuM èvan2uDhaiya ghaiyil irughghin2r2adho avan2 mighabh bharijhudhdhamAn2avan2. avan2iDhame nIGghaL dhiruMbhagh ghòNDhu varabhbhaDhuvIrghaL.
aNi aNiyAgha nir2bhavarghaL mIdhu jhadhdhiyamAgha!
(dhImaighaLaidh) dhIviramAgha viraDhDhubhavarghaL mIdhu jhadhdhiyamAgha!
(ir2aivan2in2 vajhan2aGghaLai) odhubhavarghaL mIdhu jhadhdhiyamAgha!
nijhjhayamAgha uGghaL vaNaghghadhdhir2ghuriya ir2aivan2 òre òruvan2dhAn2.
avan2e vAn2aGghaLaiyuM, bhUmiyaiyuM, avaighaLughghu madhdhiyiluLLavaighaLaiyuM bhaDhaidhdhu vaLarbhbhavan2. ghIzh dhijhai(ghaL mel dhijhai)ghaLin2 ir2aivan2uM avan2e.
nijhjhayamAgha (uGghaL ir2aivan2Aghiya) nAM, (bhUmighghujh) jhamIbhamAgha uLLa vAn2adhdhaibh bhiraghAjhighghuM naDhjhadhdhiraGghaLaigh ghòNDhu azhaghubhaDhudhdhi vaidhdhoM.
mighgha viSamighaLAn2a SaidhdhAn2ghaLughghu òru dhaDhaiyAghavuM (Aghghi vaidhdhoM).

mel ulaghadhdhil uLLavarghaLin2 viSayaGghaLai (SaidhdhAn2ghaL) jhèviyur2a muDhiyAdhu. (en2èn2r2Al, adhan2ai nèruGghuM òvvòruvaruM) bhala bhAghaGghaLilirundhuM (ghòLLi ghaLAl) èr2iyabhbhaDhDhu viraDhDhabhbhaDhughin2r2an2ar.
avarghaLughghu nilaiyAn2a vedhan2aiyuNDhu.
(dhabhbhidh dhavar2i yAdhòru vArdhdhaiyai) ir2AyJjhijh jhèlla nèruGghin2Al, uDhan2e avan2ai(gh ghòzhundhuviDhDhèriyuM) bhiraghAjhamAn2a nèrubhbhu bhin2dhòDharghir2adhu.

(nabhiye!) innirAgharibhbhavarghaLai nIGghaL gheLuGghaL: (ir2andha bhin2) uGghaLaibh bhaDhaibhbhadhu ghaSDhamA? alladhu nAM bhaDhaidhdhirughghuM (vAn2aM, bhUmi, naDhjhadhdhiraGghaL Aghiya) ivaighaLaibh bhaDhaibhbhadhu ghaSDhamA? nijhjhayamAgha nAM ivarghaLaibh bhijhu bhijhubhbhAn2a ghaLimaNNAldhAn2 bhaDhaidhdhirughghin2r2oM.
(nabhiye!) nIGghaL (allAhvin2 vallamaiyaigh ghaNDhu) AjhjhariyabhbhaDhughin2r2IrghaL; avarghaLo (adhan2aibh) bharighajhigh ghin2r2an2ar.
an2r2i, avarghaLughghu nallubhadhejhaM ghUr2iyabhodhiluM avarghaL nalluNarjhjhi bhèr2uvadheyillai.
èndha adhdhADhjhiyaigh ghaNDhabhodhiluM avarghaL bharighAjhaM jhèyghin2r2an2ar.
an2r2i "idhu bhaghiraGghamAn2a jhUn2iyameyan2r2i ver2illai" èn2r2uM ghUr2ughin2r2an2ar.
"nAM ir2andhu (ughghi) èluMbhAghavuM maNNAghavuM, bhon2a bhin2n2ar mèyyAghave nAM èzhubhbhabhbhaDhuvomA? (èn2r2uM)
(avvAr2e) naMmuDhaiya mUdhAdhaighaLumA? (èzhubhbhabh bhaDhuvArghaL" èn2r2uM bharighAjhamAghagh ghUr2ughin2r2an2ar.)
adhar2ghu (nabhiye!) nIGghaL ghUr2uGghaL: "mèydhAn2. (èzhubhbhabhbhaDhuvIrghaL.) ajhjhamayaM nIGghaL jhir2umaibhbhaDhDhavarghaLAgha irubhbhIrghaL.
adhu òre òru jhabhdhaMdhAn2; uDhan2e avarghaL (èzhundhu nin2r2u dhirudhiruvèn2r2u) vizhibhbhArghaL.
nAGghaL ghèDhDhoM! idhu ghUli ghòDhughghuM nALAyir2r2e" èn2r2uM avarghaL ghUr2uvArghaL.
(adhar2ghavarghaLai noghghi) "nIGghaL bhòyyAghghigh ghòNDhirundha dhIrbhbhu nAL idhudhAn2" (èn2r2uM ghUr2abhbhaDhuM).
aniyAyaM jhèydhavarghaLaiyuM, avarghaLuDhaiya dhozharghaLaiyuM, allAhvai an2r2i avarghaL vaNaGghigh ghòNDhirundha dhèyvaGghaLaiyuM òn2r2u jherdhdhu,
"avarghaLai naraghadhdhir2ghugh ghòNDhu jhèlluGghaL" (èn2r2uM),
"aGghu avarghaLai nir2udhdhi vaiyuGghaL; nijhjhayamAgha avarghaLaigh (gheLvi ghaNaghghugh) gheDhgha veNDhiyadhirughghin2r2adhu" (èn2r2uM ghUr2abhbhaDhuM).

"uGghaLughghu èn2n2a nerndhadhu? (ulaghadhdhil nIGghaL òruvarughghòruvar udhavi jhèydhu ghòNDhirundhabhaDhi iGghu) nIGghaL en2 òruvarughghòruvar udhavi jhèydhu ghòLLavillai" (èn2r2uM gheDhghabhbhaDhuM).
èn2in2uM, an2r2aiya dhin2aM avarghaL dhalai ghun2indha varghaLAgha irubhbhArghaL.
avarghaLil òruvar mar2r2òruvaruDhan2 dharghghighgha mur2bhaDhDhu,
(jhilar dhaGghaL dhalaivarghaLai noghghi) "nijhjhayamAgha nIGghaL naMmiDhaM bhalavandhamAghave van(dhu uGghaLughghu vazhibhbhaDhuMbhaDhi èGghaLai nirbhbhandhidh)dhIrghaL" èn2r2u ghUr2uvArghaL.
adhar2ghu a(dhdhalai)varghaL "avvAr2an2r2u. (nAGghaL uGghaLaidh dhaDhai jhèyyavillai.) nIGghaLdhAM naMbhighghai ghòLLavillai."
"èGghaLughghu uGghaL mIdhu yAdhòru adhighAramuM irughghavillai. nIGghaLdhAM bhòllAdha maghghaLAgha irundhIrghaL.
AdhalAl, èGghaL ir2aivan2uDhaiya vAghghu èGghaLughghu uNmaiyAghi viDhDhadhu. nijhjhayamAgha nAM an2aivaruM (vedhan2aiyaijh) jhuvaighgha veNDhiyavarghaLe.
nijhjhayamAgha nAGghaL uGghaLai vazhighèDhudhdhoM. en2èn2r2Al, nAGghaL vazhighèDhDhe bhoyirundhoM èn2r2u ghUr2uvArghaL.
muDhivil nijhjhayamAgha avarghaL an2aivaruM an2r2aiya dhin2aM vedhan2aiyil (jhama) bhaGghALiyAgha irubhbhArghaL.
nijhjhayamAgha nAM, ghur2r2avALighaLai ivvAr2e naDhadhdhuvoM.

"allAhvaidh dhavira (uGghaLughghu) vaNaghghadhdhir2ghuriya ver2òru ir2aivan2 illai; (avan2aiye nIGghaL vaNaGghuGghaL)" èn2r2u avarghaLughghugh ghUr2abhbhaDhDhAl, nijhjhayamAgha avarghaL gharvaM ghòNDhu,
"èn2n2e! nAGghaL bhaidhdhiyaM bhiDhidhdha òru ghaviJarughghAgha èGghaLuDhaiya dhèyvaGghaLai mèyyAghave viDhDhu viDhuvomA?" èn2r2uM avarghaL ghUr2ughin2r2an2ar.
"(avar bhaidhdhiyaghghArar) an2r2u. avar uNmaiyaiye ghòNDhu vandhAr. (dhan2aghghu mun2n2ar vandha) nabhimArghaLaiyuM avar uNmaiyAghghi vaidhdhAr. (ivar2r2ai èllAM nIGghaL bhòyyAghghi viDhDhIrghaL.)
AdhalAl, nijhjhayamAgha nIGghaL dhun2bhur2udhdhuM vedhan2aiyai an2ubhavighgha veNDhiyadhudhAn2.
nIGghaL jhèydhughòNDhirundhavaighaLughghan2r2i uGghaLughghugh ghUli ghòDhughghabhbhaDhavillai" (èn2r2uM ghUr2abhbhaDhuM).
ghalabhbhar2r2a man2adhdhUymaiyuDhaiya allAhvuDhaiya aDhiyArghaLaidh dhavira.
idhdhaghaiyavarghaLughghu (allAhvin2 bhur2adhdhilirundhu melAn2a) uNavu dhayAr jhèyyabhbhaDhudhdhabhbhaDhDhirughghuM.
(in2bhamAn2a) ghan2ivarghghaGghaL ghòDhudhdhugh ghaNNiyabh bhaDhudhdhavuM bhaDhuvArghaL.
in2bhaM dharuM jhuvan2abhadhiyil irubhbhArghaL.
ghaDhDhilghaLil òruvar mar2r2òruvarai mughaM noghghi (ullAjhamAghabh bhejhighghòNDhu) uDhghArndhirubhbhArghaL.
mighadh dhèLivAn2a Ur2r2ughghaLin2 bhAn2aM nir2aindha ghuvaLaighaL avarghaLaijh jhur2r2ighghòNDhe irughghuM.
(adhu) mighgha vèNmaiyAn2adhAghavuM, ghuDhibhbhavarghaLughghu mighgha in2bhamAn2adhAghavuM irughghuM.
adhil bhodhaiye irughghAdhu; adhan2Al, avarghaLuDhaiya ar2ivuM nIGghiviDhAdhu.
avarghaLiDhadhdhil ghIzh noghghiya, aDhaghghamAn2a bhArvaiyaiyuDhaiya (hurul In2 èn2n2uM) ghaNNazhaghighaLuM irubhbhArghaL.
avarghaLin2 nir2aM (ir2aghghaighaLil) mar2aighghabhbhaDhDha (nèrubhbhugh ghozhiyin2 ilejhAn2a maJjhaL varNamuDhaiya) muDhDhaighaLaibh bholirughghuM.
avarghaLil òruvar mar2r2avarghaLai noghghi, (iMmaiyil naDhaibhèr2r2avaighaLaibh bhar2r2i maghizhjhjhiyuDhan2) bhejhigh ghòNDhirubhbhArghaL.
avarghaLil òruvar ghUr2uvAr: "(iMmaiyil) mèyyAghave èn2aghghòru naNbhan2 irundhAn2.
avan2 èn2n2ai noghghi "nijhjhayamAgha nI idhan2ai naMbhughir2AyA?" èn2r2u gheDhDhAn2.

èn2n2a! nAM ir2andhu ughghi èluMbhAghavuM, maNNAghavuM bhon2adhan2 bhin2n2ar (èzhubhbhabhbhaDhuvomA?) nijhjhayamAgha (naMmuDhaiya jhèyalghaLughghuriya) ghUlighaL ghòDhughghabhbhaDhuvomA?" èn2r2u (bharighAjhamAghagh) ghUr2ighghòNDhirundhAn2.
"(Aghave, avan2ai) nIGghaL bhArghgha viruMbhughin2r2IrghaLA? èn2r2u ghUr2i,
avan2ai èDhDhibh bhArdhdhu, avan2 naraghadhdhin2 madhdhiyil irubhbhadhaigh ghaNDhu,
(avan2ai noghghi) "allAhvin2 mIdhu jhadhdhiyamAgha! nI èn2n2ai azhidhdhuviDhave gharudhin2Ay."
"èn2 ir2aivan2uDhaiya aruL èn2aghghugh ghiDhaighghAdhirundhAl, nAn2uM (un2n2uDhan2 naraghadhdhil) jherghghabhbhaDhDhe irubhbhen2.
(idhar2ghu mun2n2ar) nAM ir2andhuviDhavillaiyA?

(bhin2n2ar uyir bhèr2r2irughghuM namaghghu) mundhiya maraNadhdhaidh dhavira ver2illai. (in2i nAM ir2aghghave mADhDhoM. jhuvan2abhadhiyil irughghuM) nAM vedhan2aighghu uLLAghghabhbhaDhavuM mADhDhoM" (èn2r2uM ghUr2uvAr).
nijhjhayamAgha idhu maghadhdhAn2adhòru bhAghghiyamAghuM.
edhuM nan2mai jhèyyaghghUDhiyavarghaL èlloruM idhaibhbhon2r2a (nar2bher2ughaLai bhèr2uvadhar2ghAgha) bhADhubhaDhavuM.
(allAhvin2 bhur2adhdhilirundhu ghiDhaighghuM) idhu melAn2a virundhA? alladhu (naraghadhdhilirughghuM) ghaLLi maraM melAn2a virundhA?
(man2idharghaLe!) nijhjhayamAgha nAM adhan2ai indha aniyAyaghghArarghaLai vedhan2ai jhèyvadhar2ghAghave uNDhubhaNNi irughghir2oM.
mèyyAghave adhu naraghadhdhin2 aDhidhdhaLadhdhilirundhu vèLibhbhaDhDha òru maramAghuM.
adhan2 ghiLaighaL SaidhdhAn2in2 dhalaighaLaibh bhol irughghuM.
nijhjhayamAgha avarghaL (dhaGghaL bhajhighghòDhumaiyin2Al) adhan2ai bhujhibhbhArghaL! in2n2uM adhilirundhe (dhaGghaL) vayir2r2ai nirabhbhigh ghòNDhirubhbhArghaL.
bhin2n2ar, adhar2ghu meluM naraghadhdhil ghòdhidhdhugh ghAyndhirughghuM (jhIzh ghalandha) dhaNNIre avarghaLughghu ghuDhibhbhAghagh ghòDhughghabhbhaDhuM.
(ivaighaLaibh bhujhidhdhugh ghuDhidhdha bhin2n2ar,) nijhjhayamAgha "jahIM" èn2r2a naraghadhdhir2ghe dhirubhbhabhbhaDhuvArghaL.
ivarghaL dhaGghaL mUdhAdhaighaLai mèyyAghave vazhi ghèDhDhavarghaLAghagh ghaNDhu ghòNDhArghaL.
avvAr2irundhuM, avarghaLuDhaiya aDhijhjhuvaDhDhaiye ivarghaL bhin2bhar2r2i oDhin2ArghaL.
ivarghaLughghu mun2n2irundha bhèruMbhAlAn2avarghaLuM (ivvAr2e) dhavar2An2a vazhiyil jhèn2r2an2ar.
nijhjhayamAgha nAM avarghaLughghuM ajhjhamUDhDhi èjhjharighghuM (naMmuDhaiya) dhUdharghaLai an2ubhbhiye vaidhdhoM.
Aghave, ajhjhamUDhDhi èjhjharighghai jhèyyabhbhaDhDha ivarghaLuDhaiya muDhivu èvvAr2Ayir2r2u èn2bhadhai (nabhiye!) nIGghaL bhAruGghaL.
allAhvuDhaiya bharijhudhdha èNNamuLLa aDhiyArghaLaidh dhavira, (mar2r2avarghaL èlloruM) naMmuDhaiya vedhan2aighghu uLLAvArghaL.
nUh (nabhi) naMmiDhaM (udhavi ghori) bhirArdhdhan2ai jhèydhAr. (nAmo) bhirArdhdhan2aighaLai aGghIgharibhbhavarghaLil mighgha nallavar.
Aghave, avaraiyuM avaruDhaiya ghuDhuMbhadhdhAraiyuM ghaDhumaiyAn2a ghaSDhadhdhilirundhu bhAdhughAdhdhugh ghòNDhoM.
avarghaLuDhaiya jhandhadhighaLaibh bhir2ghAladhdhil èn2r2ume nilaidhdhirughghuMbhaDhi jhèydhoM.
avaruDhaiya ghIrdhdhiyaiyuM, bhin2n2uLLorghaLil èn2r2ume nilaidhdhirughghuMbhaDhi jhèydhoM.
"salAM" IDher2r2aM nUhvughghu uNDhAvadhAgha! èn2r2u ulaghaM muzhuvadhilume ghUr2abhbhaDhughir2adhu.
ivvAr2e nan2mai jhèydhavarghaLughghu nAM ghUli ghòDhughghir2oM.
(nUh nabhi) naMbhighghaiyuLLa namadhu aDhiyArghaLil òruvarAghave irundhAr.
(Aghave, avaraiyuM avaraibh bhin2bhar2r2iyavarghaLaiyuM dhavira,) mar2r2avarghaLai (vèLLabh bhiraLayadhdhil) nAM mUzhghaDhidhdhu viDhDhoM.
ibhrAhIM nUh (nabhi) uDhaiya vazhiyaibh bhin2bhar2r2iyavar dhAn2.
avar (bhaNbhaDhDha) nerAn2a uLLadhdhuDhan2 dhan2 ir2aivan2iDhaM vandha jhamayadhdhil,
avar dhan2 dhandhaiyaiyuM, dhan2 maghghaLaiyuM noghghi "nIGghaL èdhan2ai vaNaGghughir2IrghaL?" èn2r2u gheDhDhu,
"nIGghaL allAhvaiyan2r2i bhòyyAn2a dhèyvaGghaLaiye viruMbhughir2IrghaLA?
avvAr2Ayin2, ulaghadhdhAraibh bhaDhaidhdhu vaLardhdhu varuM ir2aivan2aibh bhar2r2i uGghaL èNNaM èn2n2a?" èn2r2u gheDhDhAr.
"bhin2n2ar, naDhjhadhdhiraGghaLaigh ghUrndhu bhArdhdhu,
nijhjhayamAgha èn2aghghu òru noy er2bhaDhuM bhol irughghin2r2adhu" èn2r2u ghUr2ave,
avarghaL avarai viDhDhuviDhDhu (dhirunAL ghòNDhADhajh) jhèn2r2uviDhDhan2ar.

(bhin2n2ar) avar, avarghaLuDhaiya ghoyilughghuL iraghajhiyamAghajh jhèn2r2Ar. (vighghiraghaGghaLughghubh bhaDhaighghabhbhaDhDha bhala vaghai uNavughaL irughghagh ghaNDhu, jhilaighaLai noghghi) "nIGghaL ivaighaLai en2 bhujhibhbhadhillai?
uGghaLughghu èn2n2a (nerndhadhu)? nIGghaL en2 bhejhuvadhillai?" èn2r2u gheDhDhu(bh bhadhil ghiDhaighghAdhadhan2Al,)
avaighaLaibh bhalamAgha aDhidhdhudh dhAghghi (nòr2ughghiviDhDhu vèLiyil jhèn2r2u) viDhDhAr.
(dhirunAL ghòNDhADhajh jhèn2r2avarghaL dhiruMbhi vandhu idhan2aigh ghaNDhadhuM) ibhrAhImiDhaM oDhi vandhu (adhaibh bhar2r2igh gheDhghave)
avar, (avarghaLai noghghi) "uGghaL ghaighaLAl jhidhdharidhdha bhòMmaighaLai nIGghaL vaNaGghughir2IrghaLA?
uGghaLaiyuM, nIGghaL jhidhdharidhdha avaighaLaiyuM allAhve bhaDhaidhdhAn2" èn2r2Ar.

(adhar2ghu avarghaL bhadhil ghUr2a vaghaiyar2iyAdhu ghobhaM ghòNDhu,) "ivarughghAghabh bhèriyadhòru (nèrubhbhugh) ghiDhaGghai amaidhdhu, annèrubhbhil.avarai èr2indhu viDhuGghaL" èn2r2u ghUr2in2ArghaL.
ivvAr2u avarghaL, avarughghudh dhIGghizhaighghagh gharudhin2ArghaL. èn2in2uM, nAM avarghaLaiye izhivubhaDhudhdhi viDhDhoM.
bhin2n2ar, ibhrAhIM (avvUrai viDhDhu vèLibhbhaDhDhu,) "nAn2 èn2 ir2aivan2iDhame jhèlghin2r2en2. avan2 nijhjhayamAgha èn2aghghu nerAn2a vazhiyaigh ghANbhibhbhAn2" (èn2r2u ghUr2i,)
"èn2 ir2aivan2e! nallorghaLil (òruvarai) nI èn2aghghu(jh jhandhadhiyAgha) vazhaGghi aruL bhurivAyAgha!" èn2r2Ar.
AdhalAl, mighabh bhòr2umaiyuDhaiya (ismAyIl èn2n2uM) maghan2aigh ghòNDhu avarughghu nar2jhèydhi ghUr2in2oM.

(avaruDhaiya andha maghan2 avaruDhan2) naDhandhu dhiriyaghghUDhiya vayadhai aDhaindha bhòzhudhu, avar (dhan2 maghan2ai noghghi) "èn2 arumai maindhan2e! nAn2 un2n2ai (èn2n2uDhaiya ghaighòNDhu) ar2udhdhubh bhaliyiDhuvadhAgha mèyyAghave nAn2 èn2n2uDhaiya ghan2avil ghaNDhen2. (idhaibh bhar2r2i) nI èn2n2a abhibhbhirAyabhbhaDhughir2Ay?" èn2r2u gheDhDhAr. adhar2ghavar, "èn2(n2arumaidh) dhandhaiye! uGghaLughghu iDhabhbhaDhDha ghaDhDhaLaibhbhaDhiye nIGghaL jhèyyuGghaL. allAh aruL bhurindhAl (adhan2aijh jhaghidhdhughghòNDhu) ur2udhiyAyirubh van2Aghave nIGghaL èn2n2aigh ghANbhIrghaL" èn2r2u ghUr2in2Ar.
Aghave, avviruvaruM (ir2aivan2in2 virubhbhadhdhir2ghu) mur2r2iluM vazhibhbhaDhDhu, (ibhrAhIM dhan2 maghan2 ismAyIlai ar2udhdhubh bhaliyiDha) mughaGghubhbhur2agh ghiDhadhdhin2Ar.
ajhjhamayaM nAM "ibhrAhIme!" èn2a azhaidhdhu,
uNmaiyAghave nIGghaL uGghaLuDhaiya ghan2avai mèyyAghghi vaidhdhu viDhDhIrghaL èn2r2uM, nan2mai jhèybhavarughghu nAM ivvAr2e ghUli ghòDhubhbhoM" èn2r2uM ghUr2i,
"nijhjhayamAgha idhu maghadhdhAn2adhòru bhèruM jhodhan2aiyAghuM" (èn2r2uM ghUr2in2oM).
Aghave, maghadhdhAn2adhòru bhaliyai avarughghu bhagharamAghghin2oM.
avaruDhaiya ghIrdhdhiyaibh bhir2ghAladhdhiluM nilaighgha vaidhdhoM.
(Aghave, ulaghadhdhiluLLa an2aivarume) "ibhrAhImughghu "salAM" IDher2r2aM uNDhAvadhAghugha" (èn2r2uM ghUr2ughin2r2an2ar.)
ivvAr2e, nan2mai jhèydhavarghaLughghu nAM ghUli ghòDhubhbhoM.

(idhuve uGghaLadhu) bhAn2amumAghuM" èn2r2u ghUr2in2oM. (adhan2Al avaruDhaiya noyghaL ghuNamAghi viDhDhan2a.)

"òru bhiDhi (bhul) ghadhdhaiyai èDhudhdhu, adhan2aigh ghòNDhu (uGghaLadhu man2aiviyai) aDhiyuGghaL. nIGghaL uGghaLuDhaiya jhadhdhiyadhdhai mur2ighgha veNDhiyadhillai" èn2r2u ghUr2in2oM. nijhjhayamAgha nAM, avarai mighgha bhòr2umai uDhaiyavarAghave ghaNDhoM. avar mighgha nallaDhiyAr. nijhjhayamAgha avar (òvvòru viSayadhdhiluM naMmai) noghghin2avarAghave irundhAr.
(nabhiye!) namadhu aDhiyArghaL ibhrAhIM, ishAgh, yaHghUbhaiyuM nin2aidhdhubh bhAruGghaL. ivarghaL ghòDhaiyALi ghaLAghavuM, aghabhbhArvai uDhaiyavarghaLAghavuM irundhArghaL.
mar2umaiyai (maghghaLughghu) ènneramuM JAbhaghamUDhDhuvadhar2ghAgha avarghaLai nAM bhiradhyeghabhbhaDhudhdhin2oM.
avarghaL, naMmiDhadhdhil dherndhèDhughghabhbhaDhDha nallaDhi yArghaLil uLLavarghaLAghave irundhan2ar.
(nabhiye!) ismAyIl, alyasavu, dhulghiflu ivarghaLaiyuM ghavan2idhdhubh bhAruGghaL. ivarghaLan2aivaruM nallaDhiyArghaLil uLLavarghaLdhAM.
(mer2ghUr2iya) ivaighaLèllAM (naMbhighghaiyALarghaLughghu) nalla udhAraNaGghaLAghuM. nijhjhayamAgha (idhdhaghaiya) ir2ai ajhjhamuDhaiyavarghaLughghu (nalla) irubhbhiDhamuNDhu.

adhar2ghu a(dhdhalai)varghaL (bhin2 dhòDharndha) avarghaLai noghghi, "(èGghaLughghu) an2r2u; uGghaLughghudhdhAn2 nalvaravillai. nIGghaLdhAM èGghaLughghu idhan2aidh dheDhidh dhandhIrghaL. (AdhalAl, naMmiruvarin2) dhaGghumiDhaM maghA ghèDhDhadhu" èn2r2u ghUr2uvArghaL.

"èvarghaLaibh bharighAjhaM bhaNNigh ghòNDhirundhomo (avarghaL iGghirundhuM) avarghaLaibh bhArghghAdhavAr2u naMmuDhaiya ghaNghaLdhAM maGghiviDhDhan2avo!" èn2r2uM ghUr2uvArghaL.

èndha naMbhighghaiyALarghaLin2 jhandhadhighaL, dhaGghaL bhèr2r2orghaLaibh bhin2bhar2r2i naMbhighghai ghòLghin2r2ArghaLo (andhajh jhandhadhighaLin2 nan2maighaL ghur2aivAgha irundhuM avarghaLin2 bhèr2r2orghaL dhirubhdhiyaDhaiyuM bhòruDhDhu) avarghaLuDhaiya jhandhadhighaLaiyuM avarghaLuDhan2 (jhuvan2abhadhiyil) jherdhdhuviDhuvoM. idhan2Al avarghaLuDhaiya bhèr2r2orghaLin2 nan2maighaLil òn2r2aiyume nAM ghur2aidhdhuviDha mADhDhoM. òvvòru man2idhan2uM dhan2n2uDhaiya jhèyalughghubh bhiNaiyAgha irughghin2r2An2.
avarghaL viruMbhiya (bhar2bhala vaghai) ghan2i varghghaGghaLaiyuM, mAmijhaGghaLaiyuM avarghaLughghu (an2udhin2amuM) nAM (erALamAghagh) ghòDhudhdhu varuvoM.
òruvaruDhaiya ghiNNadhdhai mar2r2òruvar (ghaLibhbhAl) bhiDhuGghigh ghòLvAr. (adhan2Al) man2adhdhAGghalo alladhu mariyAdhaighghur2aivo er2bhaDhAdhu.
avarghaLughghubh bhaNi jhèyya ènneramuM jhir2uvarghaL bhalar jhur2r2ighghòNDhe irubhbhArghaL. avarghaL bhadhindha mudhdhughghaLaibh bhol (bhiraghAjhamAghadh dhor2r2amaLibhbhArghaL.)
avarghaLil òruvar mar2r2òruvarai noghghiyirundhu ghòNDhu (ullAjhamAgha) uraiyADha AraMbhidhdhu,
"idhar2ghu mun2n2ar, nAM naMmuDhaiya ghuDhuMbhadhdhaibh bhar2r2i (avarghaLuDhaiya ghadhi èn2n2avAghumo èn2r2u) mèyyAghave bhayandhu ghòNDhe irundhoM.
Ayin2uM, allAh naMmIdhu aruL bhurindhu ghòDhiya vedhan2aiyilirundhu naMmai(yuM naM ghuDhuMbhadhdhin2araiyuM) ghAbhbhAr2r2in2An2.

idhar2ghu mun2n2ar (vedhan2aiyilirundhu naMmai ghAghghuMbhaDhi) mèyyAghave nAM avan2iDhaM bhirArdhdhan2ai jhèydhu ghòNDhu irundhoM. mèyyAghave avan2 nan2r2i jhèybhavan2uM bheran2bhuDhaiyavan2umAgha irughghin2r2An2" èn2r2uM ghUr2uvArghaL.
(nabhiye!) nIGghaL (nirAgharibhbhavarghaLughghu vedhan2aiyai) JAbhaghamUDhDhighghòNDhe iruGghaL. uGghaLadhu ir2aivan2in2 aruLAl nIGghaL ghur2i jhòlbhavarumalla; bhaidhdhiyaghghArarumalla.

(uGghaLaibh bhar2r2i) avarghaL (nIGghaL) òru ghaviJardhAn2 èn2r2u ghUr2ughin2r2an2arA? (ighghUr2r2ughghudh dhaNDhan2aiyAgha avarghaL mIdhu jhaMbhavighghagh ghUDhiya) ghAlajhjhaghgharadhdhai èdhirbhArdhdhirubhbhoM.
Aghave (avarghaLai noghghi, adhan2ai) "nIGghaLuM èdhir bhArdhdhiruGghaL. (èn2n2a naDhaghghir2adhu èn2bhadhai) nijhjhayamAgha nAn2uM uGghaLuDhan2 èdhirbhArdhdhirughghin2r2en2" èn2r2u ghUr2uGghaL.
(nabhiye! uGghaLai ghur2ighArar èn2r2uM, bhaidhdhiyaghghArar èn2r2uM ghUr2uMbhaDhi) avarghaLuDhaiya ar2ivudhAn2 avarghaLaidh dhUNDhughin2r2adhA? alladhu (iyar2ghaiyAghave) avarghaL viSamighaLdhAn2A?
alladhu (namadhu nabhiyAghiya) ivar bhòyyAghave adhan2aigh ghar2bhan2ai jhèydhu ghòNDhArèn2r2u avarghaL ghUr2ughin2r2an2arA? an2r2u! (man2amuraNDhAghave) idhan2ai avarghaL naMbhighghai ghòLvadhillai.

(nabhiye! idhan2ai nIGghaL bhòyyAghagh ghar2bhan2ai jhèydhu ghòNDhIrèn2r2u ghUr2uvadhil) avarghaL uNmai jhòlbhavar ghaLAyirundhAl (avarghaLuM ghar2bhan2ai jhèydhughòNDhu) idhaibh bhon2r2a yAdhòru vAghghiyadhdhaigh ghòNDhu varavuM.

vAn2aM iDhindhu adhilirundha òru dhuNDhu vizhuvadhai ivarghaL ghaNNAl ghaNDhabhodhiluM (adhu vAn2amalla;) meghaM dhAn2 èn2r2uM, An2Al adhu ur2aindhu ir2ughiviDhDhadhèn2r2uM ghUr2uvArghaL.
(nabhiye!) ivarghaLuDhaiya ar2ivu bhar2andhuviDhagh ghUDhiya nALai ivarghaL jhandhighghuM varaiyil nIGghaL ivarghaLai viDhDhuviDhuGghaL.

(Aghave, avarghaL uGghaLaidh dhaGghaL iSDhabhbhaDhi dhun2bhur2udhdha muDhiyAdhu.) Ayin2uM, nIGghaL (nidhdhiraiyilirundhu) èzhundha neradhdhil uGghaLadhu ir2aivan2in2 bhughazhaigh ghUr2idh dhudhi jhèyvIrAgha!

avar dhan2 iSDhabhbhaDhi èdhan2aiyuM ghUr2uvadhillai.

(nabhiye!) òruvan2in2 bhAvajh jhumaiyai mar2r2òruvan2 jhumaghgha mADhDhAn2 èn2bhadhai ar2indhughòLvIrAgha.
